craft_notes: Sthāyin: entitlement with exception. Rows: entitled yet beseech. Read aloud: charter.

lines: In spell-practice, daily worship, hearing, study — entitled;
but in the occasional, everywhere, the master alone beseech.
l4.sanskrit_cite: mantrābhyāse nityapūjāyāṃ śravaṇe 'dhyayane adhikārī naimittike tu sarvatra gurum eva abhyarthayet
